message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has confirmed that the meeting has been booked. Now I need to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

I will use the `send_confirmation_email` tool to do this. I will specify the day, start time, and body of the email.

The meeting is on Thursday, November 19, at 14:30. The body of the email should be a standard meeting confirmation, stating the purpose, date, time, and attendees.

After sending the email, the task will be complete.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments:
{"day":"Thu","start":"14:30","body":"Dear Partners,

This email confirms the booking of our upcoming partners' meeting.

Date: Thursday, November 19, 2026
Time: 14:30 - 15:00 Eastern
Attendees: Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto and David Okafor.

Best regards,
Brad"}
